company.name: Cadre AI
company.description: Cadre AI is a B2B AI strategy and implementation consultancy. We work as an extension of a client's team: assessing where AI can move the needle, then building and shipping the tools and agents that do it, staying embedded through delivery rather than handing off a report and leaving.

services.name: AI Strategy & Maturity Assessment
services.description: A structured evaluation of where an organization stands on AI adoption today, and a prioritized roadmap for what to do next. Produces the AI Maturity Index score.

services.name: Embedded AI Delivery
services.description: A fractional, embedded team of strategists and engineers who design, build, and ship AI tools and agents directly inside a client's operations, not a report handed off at the end.

services.name: Custom Agent & Automation Build
services.description: Purpose-built AI agents and automations for a specific workflow, such as support, ops, or internal tooling, designed with fallback logic so they escalate rather than guess when uncertain.

services.name: LLM Selection & Data Security Advisory
services.description: Guidance on which model or models fit a given workload, and how to handle data security, retention, and compliance when integrating LLMs into existing systems.

services.name: Team Enablement
services.description: Training and playbooks so a client's own team can extend and maintain what Cadre builds, rather than staying dependent on Cadre.

industries_served.summary: Cadre AI works across industries. Every engagement starts with a scoping call to confirm fit before any commitment.
industries_served.note: Regulated industries, such as healthcare and financial services, go through an additional security and compliance review before an engagement kicks off.

ai_maturity_index.what_it_is: A lightweight scoring framework that places an organization on a four-tier scale for AI readiness: Exploring, Piloting, Scaling, Embedded. It scores across five dimensions: data readiness, tooling, process integration, organizational buy-in, and security posture.
ai_maturity_index.how_to_get_scored: Book a scoping call with an AI strategist. The initial assessment is a no-cost, roughly 45-minute conversation, and it does not require an engagement commitment.

tiers.Exploring: Early conversations, no production AI use yet.
tiers.Piloting: One or more narrow AI pilots running, results not yet proven at scale.
tiers.Scaling: AI tools in production for at least one core workflow, expanding to others.
tiers.Embedded: AI is a standard part of how the organization operates, with clear ownership and measurement.

llm_and_data_security.model_selection_approach: Cadre is model-agnostic. Model choice is driven by the task: latency and cost for high-volume workflows, reasoning depth for complex judgment calls, and data sensitivity for anything touching regulated or proprietary data. Cadre defaults to retrieval-based or staged-checkpoint approaches over full model autonomy for anything high-stakes, favoring trust over raw capability.
llm_and_data_security.data_handling: Client data is never used to train third-party models. Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Model providers are selected in part on their data retention and limited-retention options. Standard engagements include an NDA before any client data is shared.
llm_and_data_security.escalation_principle: Every AI system Cadre builds follows the same rule: escalate to a human rather than guess when confidence is low. This is a design principle across every engagement, not just how the support bot itself behaves.

booking.url: (injected at runtime from the BOOKING_URL environment variable)
booking.how_to_book: Book a call with an AI strategist directly using the scheduling link (the url field) — pick an open time and it's confirmed instantly, no back-and-forth needed. Initial calls run about 30 to 45 minutes and are free.
booking.what_to_expect: The first call is a scoping conversation covering current state and goals, and whether Cadre is a fit. It is not a sales pitch.

client_portal.purpose: Existing clients use the portal to track active AI tools and agents, project status, and measured results, such as ticket reduction or time saved.
client_portal.access: Portal access is provisioned by the client's engagement lead once a project kicks off. Anyone without access, or locked out, should be escalated rather than guessing at credentials.
